description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class `HolidayDaoTest` for the `HolidayDao` data access object in the OrangeHRM Leave Plugin module. It includes setup, various test cases for CRUD operations and searching holidays within the database, and uses test data fixtures for testing.

classes.name: HolidayDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the HolidayDao data access object functionalities such as get, save, delete, and search holiday records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates a HolidayDao instance, and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetHolidayById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a holiday record by its ID.

methods.name: testSaveHoliday
methods.description: Tests saving and updating a holiday record.

methods.name: testSaveHolidayWithNoId
methods.description: Tests creating a new holiday record without an initial ID.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromToDates
methods.description: Tests searching holidays without specifying date filters and including all.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromToDatesAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests search with exclude recurring filter set.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromDateAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests search with only end date and exclude recurring filter.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutToDateAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests search with only start date and exclude recurring filter.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests date range search with exclude recurring set, checking filtered holidays.

methods.name: testSearchHolidays
methods.description: Tests searching holidays within a specific date range.

methods.name: testGetHolidayByDate
methods.description: Tests retrieving a holiday by specific date, including recurring holidays.

methods.name: testDeleteHolidays
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple holidays by IDs.
